notes: A single-time filter emits objects valid at that time from history input, excluding deleted objects in the resulting snapshot. It streams one pass; that reduces working memory but does not reduce bytes needed from its source. Filtering a later state-only file cannot recover superseded/deleted versions that are absent from it.

notes: complete_ways uses two passes, selects in-region nodes and ways referencing them, and completes those ways nodes. simple is the pipe-capable strategy and leaves boundary ways incomplete. The documented node-seeded selection does not establish inclusion of a segment crossing a bbox with no interior node. Memory depends on number of extracts, highest node ID and strategy.
